title: DeHub’s next chapter: Riftn, our BNB recovery push, and the road to relaunch
html:
Good evening everyone

Thanks for joining us for this Town Hall, and potentially the most important in our history.

I don't say that lightly and I hope we see this moment as a turning point for our future.

In brief: I’m confident we have a strong case for recovering the BNB stuck in our old contract. I’ve finally secured the short, catchy and meaningful .com I’ve spent years looking for, and this update reveals the new name and explains our plan for relaunching and getting listed.

Binance offers a programme called the Pioneer Burn, which recovers lost BNB on BNB chain from quarterly Binance burns. This programme specifically states it's for accidental transfers or bugged contracts. Even in their most recent burn, a large amount was recovered for pioneer burns, so they still actively offer this.

The issue is, we've been ignored by Binance's support team, as the only way we were instructed to apply was via the binance support chat, where I was asked what an LP was. As many of you know, BNB tweeted us last year, after my efforts to start the process of recovery, yet the team we worked with were all let go by BNB chain before we could get an answer from Binance. The contact Walter who was head of BD at BNB Chain, and the one trying to help us recover the BNB, said we need to get loud on twitter and get the Binance teams attention.

For our relaunch, there is simply no bigger catalyst than the near $1m of our community's money that's stuck and can be easily recovered by Binance, who even offer to do this exact thing for these exact situations, and continue to until this most recent burn.

Here's the plan.

First, we need a better name. This is something I've been trying to resolve for three years. DeHub was great initially but we've outgrown it, and the domain pigeonholes us into crypto/tech whereas we need to appeal to the general public, the masses. The icon logo will remain, as everyone loves it and it perfectly symbolises our new name, but as of next week, as long as most of you vote with me, we will be riftn.com.

Rifting is the geological process of the Earth’s crust pulling apart to form new seas, land and life through disruptive volcanic eruptions. There is simply not a better word in the English dictionary we can think of that describes what we're trying to do here, and what happens if we succeed. Riftn.com — spelt R-I-F-T-N, dot com — is a high-value domain that carries perfect meaning, it is the domain we've all been waiting for, for years. This means there will be a new token that combines everyone onto one contract, while remaining in-app compatability for base, robinhood, solana, arc, ethereum and bnb, as we are today.

After that, we're going to focus on BNB while publicly appealing for the pioneer burn, as transactions have come down to similar levels compared to Base and the app can be sustained easily, especially with talks of the next upgrade from BNB. This also gives us the best chance of capturing the attention and hearts of the binance team as well as the wider crypto community and general public.

A few years ago when we shifted focus on Base, it made sense, transactions were 10x cheaper and BNB was not being worked on, no github updates for years, endless bugs affecting our development, and other issues we highlighted in the past. That's all changed now, and Base have gone above and beyond to show us how much they hate any builders on their chain, from stealing open source projects and funding vamp clones to supporting ponzi schemes by notorious bad actors, we cannot in good faith continue focussing on base as our main chain, yet will keep compatibility for obvious reasons.

If we step back and assess the DeHub situation as a whole, this route gives us the highest probability of a successful launch, that actually captures attention and mindshare across CT and the world.

Your balances as they are will remain. The app already reads your correct staked balances and holdings across both chains, so you'll just need to log in once to claim your balance after listing. The new token will bring everyone on the same chain and contract, giving as clean of a fresh start as possible. You do not need to visit any websites, speak to any admins or share your keys with anyone or anywhere, everything will happen on riftn.com. Stay tuned for more information on the new token and switchover soon.

If for any reason we get rejected, we can reassess the situation and re-plan a better listing strategy, but I genuinely believe this is the best way forward that gives us the highest odds at a strong relaunch. I don't see a scenario where we don't get the support of the wider crypto community as we start asking the question publicly. We meet every criterion needed for the pioneer burn to recover our BNB and with the right rally, that money is ours again. In the worst-case scenario, Binance rejects our request and we consider Solana. I've had some good conversations with members of their ecosystem and am open to exploring that avenue. However, I can’t see that happening as it would be terrible PR for them to not follow through on promises of their own offers.

All of this can happen quickly, and I hope it does. The fireworks will begin on the 5th of November and they won't stop until we get an answer but if we're really getting nowhere by mid/late November then we will execute the alternative listing strategy we’re preparing.

On timing, I feel it's important to ensure we are trading before December, the start of the holiday season where everyone will be at home, browsing the web, spending money.

I look forward to hearing your thoughts. Feel free to share them in posts on the app!
